title: Knowledge MCP
subtitle: Build your own MCP server from plugins. Auth and permissions are built in

steps.title: Create
steps.desc: npx create-knowledge-mcp makes a server with a local store. Or run one Docker command

steps.title: Add a tool
steps.desc: One file in src/plugins: a name, a zod input and a run function

steps.title: Authorize
steps.desc: Checks the API key or OAuth token, then loads the person's role

steps.title: Use
steps.desc: Claude sees only the tools this person may use, and calls them
